page_title: BOU 1-1 MNU | Bournemouth v Manchester Utd 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+8' Here comes a substitution. Dango Ouattara is given a rest as he is replaced by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).
90+6' 1 - 1 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!

90+5' He should have scored! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Kepa Arrizabalaga makes an easy save.
90+4' Wasted opportunity. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
90+4' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+3' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+3' Manchester Utd quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' A long ball forward to Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is intercepted. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.

90+2' That's unlucky! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
90+2' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the top left corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a brilliant save. Manchester Utd have a corner.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Patrick Dorgu makes way for Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
90' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after the corner and unleashes a shot which flies well wide of the right post.
90' Corner kick. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.

89' What a great touch by Mason Mount (Manchester United) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Manchester Utd win a corner.
86' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

86' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) for Antoine Semenyo.

83' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
83' He should have scored! Mason Mount (Manchester United) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
81' Mason Mount (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
79' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Luke Shaw (Manchester United) for a tough tackle.
78' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
77' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' The attendance for today's match is 11241.

76' What a chance! Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
75' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) replaces Noussair Mazraoui.
75' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
75' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Substitution. Justin Kluivert is replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
72' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Alex Scott will be replaced by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth).
70' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) attempts to discuss the decision with Peter Bankes, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
70' We have witnessed a sending off. Evanilson (Bournemouth) is shown a red card and it's an early bath for him I guess.
70' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Evanilson (Bournemouth). He’s got to go!

69' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Evanilson (Bournemouth), but referee Peter Bankes must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
66' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Harry Maguire.
65' It is time for a substitution. Mason Mount (Manchester United) is on for Kobbie Mainoo.
65' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Casemiro is replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
65' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
65' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
65' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Casemiro (Manchester United), but it's just wide of the right post.
64' There's an opportunity for Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

64' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Kepa Arrizabalaga, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
63' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card!
62' The corner from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is hurriedly cleared.
61' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
61' What a magnificent shot by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth). Unfortunately for him, his free kick effort rattles the right post.
58' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
57' The foul by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Peter Bankes.
56' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
55' Peter Bankes has a clear sight and sees a foul from Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
54' The corner from Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence.
53' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) launches a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana is alert to thwart the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.

53' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
51' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is flagged for offside.
51' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
49' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) tries to find Evanilson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
47' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+2' What a chance that is! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' The foul by Evanilson (Bournemouth) was seen by Peter Bankes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' Handball by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
39' The corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

38' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga reacts superbly to deny him. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

37' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

37' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
36' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
36' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Peter Bankes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) and blew his whistle.
32' Evanilson (Bournemouth) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
30' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) works the corner short.
28' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
26' Casemiro (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Peter Bankes saw the whole situation.
23' 1 - 0 Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
23' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Tyler Adams (Bournemouth).

23' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth), but referee Peter Bankes must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
22' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Peter Bankes ignores the protests.
21' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
20' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

17' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
17' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

15' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Bournemouth, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
13' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
13' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Peter Bankes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) takes a direct free kick.
12' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth have a free kick.

11' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Kepa Arrizabalaga is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
8' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' A lofted pass finds Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
4' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Evanilson, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
3' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Peter Bankes.
